name: Agenda
summary: A programme in time order: each slot's time, then the sessions that run then, side by side when they're parallel, each with its kind, title, people and place. For a conference or a course day, an itinerary or a broadcast schedule. Days or tracks go in Tabs around it. Not for picking a date (Calendar) or for rows of records to sort (DataTable).
a11y: An ordered list of slots, each with its times in `<time>` elements and a list of sessions; each session title is a heading at `headingLevel`, so a screen reader can move session by session, and a link when it has a page. Parallel sessions read in order; the kind is a text label, never colour alone. Breaks are ordinary text with no heading.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the agenda for assistive technology: "Thursday 12 March".

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The level of each session's title, under the heading that introduces the agenda.

props.name: kind
props.description: What kind of session, in a word or two: "Keynote", "Workshop", "Panel". Shown as a label.

props.name: pause
props.description: A shared moment rather than a session (a break, lunch, registration): set quieter, with no surface.

props.name: start
props.description: When it starts, as the reader reads it: "09:30".

props.name: end
props.description: When it ends, as the reader reads it.

props.name: dateTime
props.description: The start as a machine-readable time ("2027-03-12T09:30"), for `<time datetime>`.

props.name: sessions
props.description: The sessions that run at this time; more than one run side by side.
